newsitem.title: UK: BRB-Banco de Brasilia signs $75 mln EMTN programme.
newsitem.headline: BRB-Banco de Brasilia signs $75 mln EMTN programme.

text.p: BRB-Banco de Brasilia officials signed a $75 million Euro-medium term note programme on Monday at a ceremony attended by journalists and bankers.
The state-owned bank will raise funds through private placements, with the first $15 million three-year tranche expected in January 1997, an official at arranger Paxton Securities said.
Between $50 and $60 million would be issued in 1997, and the rest of the programme would be used for short-term funding requirements, the official said.
The Federal District of Brasilia is the main shareholder of BRB-Banco de Brasilia, and the bank plays an important role in development of the region, governor Cristovam Buarque said.
"We are in the process of a number of structural projects to develop the (Brasilia) area," Buarque said.
He said a number of incentives existed to encourage growth, including a financial fund. This is where BRB came in, he said.

"The government has counted on BRB for the implementation of programmes with social and economic objectives for the development of rural and urban productive activities, particularly through financial and technical support to small businessmen," BRB's president Luis Fernando Victor said.
